technical_requirements:
- Throughput: 200 reqs/sec peak for summaries during product launches (traffic spikes 3-4x baseline).
- Latency SLO: 200-400ms p95 for 1-line summary; 800ms p95 for 3-tag suggestion + confidence score.
- Accuracy target: 90% tag precision in top-1, 85% in top-3.
- Model preferences: acceptable open models (Llama2-like variants), Redwood-verified quantized variants for Dedicated.
- Fallbacks: route to cheaper model during capacity shortage; auto-degrade to batched nightly summaries for low-priority queues.
- Integrations: Zendesk app (ticket sidebar), Freshdesk webhook middleware, support for macros and triggers via API.
- Observability: token-level cost per route, per-tag confusions, per-agent adoption metrics.
poc_scope:
- 4 week POC: Integrate with staging Zendesk, ingest 50k tickets, deliver real-time 1-line summaries + 3 suggested tags.
- Deliverables: Zendesk app (iframe + API), tagging classifier, confidence threshold control, latency/cost dashboard.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 800ms, tag precision top-1 >= 88%, agent adoption >= 35% click-through on suggestions.
- Milestones: week1 infra + sample ingest, week2 model tuning + baseline eval, week3 UI integration, week4 pilot with 2 teams.
- Exit criteria for next phase: if metrics met and security sign-off -> propose Dedicated reservation quote.
business_case:
- Primary goal: reduce average handling time by 18-25% by surfacing summaries & tags.
- Secondary: faster routing to correct team -> reduce escalations by ~12%.
- Estimated cost per ticket with Redwood (projected): $0.003 - $0.01 depending on batching/quantization.
- Expected ROI within 9-12 months for ARR range if production rollout to all CS teams.
risk_assessment:
- Data residency & retention: must prove US-only logs and per-customer retention controls.
- Hallucination risk on macros -> need guardrails and rollback plan.
- Spike handling: need autoscale + graceful degradation (fallback to batch).
- App approval in Zendesk marketplace could add 4-6 weeks.
